title: Fix a feature-flag build break in a dependency declaration
goal: After a dependency cleanup, the inv-api crate no longer compiles. Restore the build so every crate's tests pass, without changing any Rust source file and without changing what other crates get by default. Run the tests.

context.targeted: inv-api calls an inv-model function that is behind a Cargo feature.

acceptance.description: inv-api compiles and parses SKUs leniently; inv-model's default features are unchanged.

expected_failure_modes: making the function unconditional in source
turning the feature on by default for every user
